metric.value: nearly 1000 m in UNESCO nomination; competing 880 m and 1200 m values remain unresolved
metric.denominator: vertical drop between an explicitly defined cliff-top point and lowland endpoint

metric.period: 2010 nomination dossier plus circulating secondary figures
metric.basis: descriptive vertical drop, not a Survey Department geodetic measurement

bounded_by: Do not select 880 m or 1,200 m until measurement endpoints and Survey Department elevation data are identified.
notes: Metric contradiction retained rather than averaged.
